examples.text: A walking path rims the island.

raw_glosses: (transitive) To follow the contours, possibly creating a circuit.
glosses: To follow the contours, possibly creating a circuit.

examples.text: The golf ball rimmed the cup.
The basketball rimmed in ... and out.

raw_glosses: (transitive or intransitive, of a ball) To roll around a rim.
(bartending) To coat the rim of a glass with salt or another powder.
glosses: To coat the rim of a glass with salt or another powder.

trans.sense: the second part of a syllable
